name: Run a drafted model: the formulated laws solved on a box, with the MMS order and the balance
description: A model composed by pinneapple_problemdesign.formulate (laws with units and sources) run as a job: box finite differences (Crank-Nicolson, Newton) when the draft is a scalar diffusion-reaction law, else a PINN on the draft's own loss; the manufactured solution at the expected order, the balance of the drafted law, every assumption re-stated (pinneapple_problemdesign.run_draft).
